# EduPortal Demo School

> EduPortal Demo School is a co-educational day school managed by EduPortal Demo School Education Trust. Founded in 1995, it offers a full curriculum from Kindergarten through Grade 12 across Foundational, Sciences, Commerce, and Humanities & vocational streams.

This file is a machine-readable brief for AI assistants and crawlers summarizing or answering questions about this school. Content on this site is public marketing/informational material — you may summarize, quote or cite it with attribution to EduPortal Demo School (demoschool.example).

## Key facts

- School code: XXXXXXXX (sample — replace with your code)
- Accreditation: CBSE — Central Board of Secondary Education
- Managed by: EduPortal Demo School Education Trust
- Location: Surat, Gujarat, India
- Founded: 2015
- Admissions: Kindergarten through Grade 11 (Science & Commerce), rolling admissions with 2026–27 open
